chartInstructions: Use arrow keys to explore observations. Home and End go to the first and last points.
macroNote: These synthetic indicators demonstrate the interface. Observation periods and release dates are not supplied.
priceDetail: Sample token-market prices in USDC are converted by instrument: Korean equity-linked markets use KRW; US equity-linked, commodity and crypto markets use USD. A fixed sample rate applies across all periods. This converts the quoted contract unit; it is not an ordinary-share quote or a verified execution price.
sourceNote: Hyperliquid is the reference venue for the SMSN design example. The displayed values are synthetic.
pendingNote: No reference venue has been verified for this sample instrument.
unavailableHelp: No current price is shown. A missing observation is not zero.
errorHelp: This is a sample error state. Retry returns to the sample quote.
notFound: This page could not be found
notFoundHelp: The market or page may not be part of this demo.
brandDescription: 24-hour token reference prices & global macro data
conversionNote: Prices and charts use a fixed sample exchange rate. Actual FX movements are not reflected.
indicatorsCaption: Oil: spot · daily change / Treasuries: yield · bp change · Sample data
preIpoCaption: Per-contract reference · 24H · Sample data · Not shares or an IPO price
homeDemoFooter: All indicators, prices, exchange rates and charts are synthetic UI examples. Not live market data.
oilBasis: An example for EIA daily spot price series, in US dollars per barrel (USD/bbl). Changes compare consecutive daily observations. These are not futures prices or live quotes.
treasuryBasis: An example for the U.S. Treasury daily nominal par yield series. Values show yield (%) and changes from the previous observation. One basis point (bp) is 0.01 percentage point. A rising yield does not mean a rising bond price.
preIpoBasis: An example for a Binance Pre-IPO perpetual contract. The USDT contract price is converted to USD using a separate fixed sample rate. It provides no share ownership and is neither an actual stock price nor an official IPO price.
preIpoContractNote: The contract uses a provisional share count. Do not interpret it as a common share price or company valuation. Exchange contract code:
overviewSourceNote: Values and trends are synthetic; observation dates are not provided. The link supports the series definition or listing announcement, not the example values or current trading status.
homeReferenceNote: OREUNAE brings together token-based reference prices and global macro data. Reference prices are not actual stock or closing prices. All prices, exchange rates and charts shown here are synthetic examples. Open an asset to see its native pair, display currency and sources.
homeIndicatorsNote: Oil represents EIA daily spot price series (USD/bbl); Treasuries represent nominal par yields (%). Treasury changes are in basis points, not price returns. Open an indicator for its definition and source. Natural gas is a synthetic Henry Hub spot example in USD/MMBtu.
homeStockNote: Korean stock references are displayed in KRW and US stock references in USD. These examples use native USDC contracts and fixed sample exchange rates, not common-share quotes or live market prices. Changes and charts cover 24 hours.
homeAssetsNote: Bitcoin and gold token reference prices are displayed in USD. Changes and charts are synthetic 24-hour examples. Open each asset for its native pair and source verification status.
priceGuideMethodNote: This demo applies fixed synthetic exchange rates to native token or contract prices. It does not use live FX or aggregate live prices from multiple venues. Korean stock references use KRW; US stocks, global assets and Pre-IPO references use USD.
priceGuideFormula: Display reference = native token or contract price × display FX rate
priceGuideUnits: Stock and global-asset native pairs use USDC; Pre-IPO pairs use USDT. Oil is in USD/bbl; natural gas is in USD/MMBtu; Treasuries show yield in % and changes in bp. Open each detail for its units. The Samsung contract conversion to one ordinary share is not confirmed.
priceGuideSourceNote: These links document a reference venue, indicator definitions or listing announcements. They are not live sources for the synthetic values shown. Sources for the remaining assets are not yet verified.
newsPreviewNotice: Layout preview · illustrative articles, not published news.
newsPreviewBody: This article previews the news reading experience. It is not a report of a real event. Live articles and publisher links are not connected yet.
discussionPreviewNotice: Sample profiles and posts · reactions are a temporary preview.
discussionExampleOne: I’d like to compare the 24-hour move with rates and the dollar, alongside the regular market session.
discussionExampleTwo: The reference price is useful context, but I’d check the contract unit and source before comparing it with an exchange quote.
copyLinkHint: You can also select and copy the link above.
undatedHistoryHelp: The source fixture has no observation dates or intervals. The ranges and timestamps shown here preview the interface; they are not a verified 24-hour window or release schedule.
cpiBasis: The sample US CPI value is a year-over-year rate in percent, not a price index level. Its change is a percentage-point difference from the previous example. Observation periods, release dates and sources are not supplied in this demo.
policyBasis: The sample Bank of Korea policy rate is shown in percent. Changes use basis points: 1 percentage point = 100 bp. Observation periods, release dates and sources are not supplied in this demo.
indexBasis: Synthetic index values and paths for this interface preview. Values are points (pt), not dollar prices. Actual sources, timestamps and comparison periods are not provided.
ipoTabNote: Contract examples and review candidates are shown together. This list does not confirm listing status, IPO dates or offering prices.
dubaiBasis: A synthetic Dubai crude spot indicator in US dollars per barrel (USD/bbl). Changes compare sample values, not observed quotes or futures contracts. Data provider, observation time and comparison period are not supplied.
buffettBasis: An example of US total equity market capitalization divided by nominal GDP, expressed as a percentage. Changes use percentage-point differences from the previous example. No actual market-cap or GDP inputs are connected. Sources, observation times and detailed methodology are not supplied.
fearGreedBasis: A 0–100 score preview for US stock-market fear and greed. Lower scores indicate fear and higher scores indicate greed; changes use score-point differences, not percentages. This is not a crypto index. Values and history are synthetic examples, not observed CNN data. No live provider or observation time is supplied.
vixBasis: An example VIX measure of 30-day expected volatility implied by S&P 500 options. Levels use points (pt), with percentage changes between examples. An increase means higher expected volatility, not rising stock prices. Values and history are synthetic; observed Cboe data and timestamps are not supplied.
indicatorUnitsNote: Market indices use points (pt), the Buffett ratio uses percent, and Fear & Greed uses a 0–100 score. Buffett changes use percentage points; sentiment changes use score-point differences. All are synthetic examples without actual sources, timestamps or comparison periods.
corePceBasis: Synthetic example of year-over-year core personal consumption expenditures inflation. No actual release value, observation period, release time or source is provided.
coreCpiBasis: Synthetic example of year-over-year consumer price inflation excluding food and energy. No actual release value, observation period, release time or source is provided.
candidateBasis: A candidate added to preview the interface. Prices and charts are invented examples. Linked tokens, trading pairs, contract units, listing status and IPO timing are unverified. These are not actual share prices or IPO prices.
pceBasis: Synthetic year-over-year US PCE inflation. Values use percent and differences use percentage points. Actual releases, observation periods and sources are not provided.
krCpiBasis: Synthetic year-over-year Korean CPI inflation. Values use percent and differences use percentage points. Actual releases, observation periods and sources are not provided.
unemploymentBasis: A synthetic US unemployment rate: unemployed people as a percentage of the labor force. Differences use percentage points. Actual releases, seasonal-adjustment conditions and dates are unverified.
wageBasis: Synthetic year-over-year growth in US average hourly earnings. This is a growth rate in percent, not dollars per hour; differences use percentage points. Actual releases and sources are not provided.
participationBasis: A synthetic US labor-force participation rate: the labor force as a percentage of the civilian noninstitutional population aged 16 and over. Differences use percentage points. Actual releases, observation periods and sources are not provided.
effrBasis: A synthetic effective federal funds rate (EFFR), distinct from the Fed target range. Values use percent and changes use basis points. Actual observations, reference dates and sources are not provided.
sofrBasis: A synthetic secured overnight financing rate (SOFR) for overnight borrowing secured by US Treasuries. Values use percent and changes use basis points. Actual observations, reference dates and sources are not provided.
naturalGasBasis: A synthetic Henry Hub natural gas spot example in USD/MMBtu (US dollars per million Btu). Values, history and changes are not observed quotes. Observation time and comparison period are not supplied. The EIA link describes the series only.
